children: Applied Digital reported fiscal first quarter 2027 revenue of $341.9 million and a net loss attributable to common stockholders from continuing operations of $221.0 million (basic and diluted loss per share $0.76). On a non-GAAP basis excluding ChronoScale, adjusted revenue was $300.4 million, adjusted net loss was $4.1 million (adjusted diluted loss per share $0.01) and adjusted EBITDA was $64.4 million. The company ended the quarter with $3.7 billion in cash, cash equivalents and restricted cash and $6.4 billion in debt.
Total revenue (GAAP): $341.9 million for the quarter ended August 31, 2026.
Net loss attributable to common stockholders (continuing operations): $221.0 million; basic and diluted loss per share: $0.76.
Adjusted net loss (Non-GAAP): $4.1 million; adjusted net loss per diluted share: $0.01.
Adjusted EBITDA (Non-GAAP): $64.4 million; Net Operating Income (Non-GAAP): $58.8 million.
Signed a 210 MW, 15-year lease at Delta Forge 2 with a tier-one investment-grade hyperscaler, representing approximately $5.2 billion of base-term contracted revenue.

Delivered Phase 1 (75 MW) of Building 2 at Polaris Forge 1 Ready for Service on July 1, 2026 and delivered the second 75 MW phase Ready for Service on October 1, 2026, bringing Polaris Forge 1 live capacity to 250 MW across two buildings and 10 data halls.

Closed $1.59 billion of 7.000% Senior Secured Notes due 2031 via subsidiary APLD ComputeCo 3 LLC to fund construction of the third HPC building (150 MW) at Polaris Forge 1 and to repay a $300 million bridge facility.

Expanded international footprint with an agreement for up to ~1 GW of potential power capacity in Finland and entered a Power Purchase Agreement with Base Electron for capacity and energy from an ~1,200 MW natural gas-fired generation facility in North Dakota.

HPC Hosting: leases for ~1.41 GW of critical IT load across five campuses representing ~ $36 billion of contracted revenue over initial base terms (approximately $86 billion including renewal options); HPC Hosting revenue for the quarter totaled $262.6 million with $33.4 million of segment operating profit.
